//: Copy to guard.config.json and fill in. That file is yours: the template never overwrites it, and it should be committed so your teammates get the same protection.
//deployBranch: The branch your pipelines deploy from. Pushing it ships.
//guardedRepos: Folder names under Codebase/ that deploy from it. A repo is guarded when one of its remotes matches one of these names.
//ciOrg: Azure DevOps organization whose pipeline, PR and REST rules apply. Leave as-is if you do not use Azure DevOps; those rules then never match.
